notes.100596: Knappogue Castle 12 is a triple-distilled Irish single malt made from 100% malted barley and matured in ex-bourbon casks. Light and clean: pear, green apple, honey, butter biscuit and a touch of toasted oak, with peach and banana showing through.
notes.100598: Knappogue Castle 16 is a triple-distilled, unpeated Irish single malt aged about 14 years in ex-bourbon barrels, then finished in Oloroso sherry casks for the rest of its 16 years. The sherry adds nutty, dried-fruit depth to the honeyed, fruity Irish malt.
notes.102176: Master's Keep Triumph is a limited Wild Turkey release and the oldest age-stated rye the distillery has bottled: a 10-year-old Kentucky straight rye at 104 proof. Expect honey, maple, butterscotch and grape with baking spice, cocoa and old oak, more dessert-like than grain-forward.
notes.102421: The Unicorn's Tale is a 14-year-old Islay single malt from Ardbeg's Anthology Collection, matured in ex-bourbon and Madeira casks and bottled at 46% ABV. Ardbeg's powerful peat smoke meets lime, peach and baked banana bread, with menthol, clove and wood smoke on the finish.
notes.560305: Sonoma-Cutrer Russian River Ranches is a California Chardonnay blended from vineyard lots across the Sonoma Coast appellation. Rich and fruit-forward, with Bosc pear and Honeycrisp apple, crisp acidity and subtle barrel spice; vintages vary.
notes.610081: Rombauer's Carneros Chardonnay is the winery's signature California Chardonnay, aged in American and French oak. Expect ripe yellow peach, melon and honeysuckle with vanilla, toasted oak, a creamy middle and a buttery finish, held up by bright acidity; vintages vary.
notes.902864: Arran 10 is the flagship single malt from the Isle of Arran's Lochranza Distillery, matured mainly in bourbon casks with part finished in first-fill Oloroso sherry, and bottled at 46% ABV with no added color or chill filtration. Expect honey, vanilla, citrus and orchard fruit with a little dried fruit and spice from the sherry.
notes.909810: Lindemans Apple (formerly called Pomme) is a Belgian fruit lambic: young lambic beer blended with red and green apple, at 3.5% ABV. Hazy gold and light-bodied, it's sweet up front with fresh, crisp apple and a gentle green-apple tartness.
notes.919869: JUSTIN Cabernet Sauvignon comes from Paso Robles, California, hand-picked and berry-sorted, then aged 15 months in small oak barrels. Expect red and black cherry, blackcurrant, cocoa, cedar and spice with soft tannins; vintages vary.
notes.921500: A Blanton's Single Barrel bourbon picked by a store or group through Buffalo Trace's barrel select program. Blanton's is drawn from single barrels in Buffalo Trace's Warehouse H and bottled at 93 proof; expect vanilla, caramel and butterscotch with citrus, oak and baking spice. Each barrel tastes a little different.
notes.925455: DRC's Corton is a Grand Cru red Burgundy (Pinot Noir) and the first wine picked in Domaine de la Romanée-Conti's 2022 harvest; this listing is the 2022 vintage. Critics describe plums and red-fruit preserve with exotic spice and creamy new oak, soft, velvety and succulent.
notes.925456: Échézeaux is a Grand Cru red Burgundy (Pinot Noir) from Domaine de la Romanée-Conti; this listing is the 2022 vintage. Critics call it fleshy and expressive, with sweet dark berries and cherries, incense, orange zest, spice and peony, and a broad, juicy finish.
notes.925457: Grands-Échézeaux is a Grand Cru red Burgundy (Pinot Noir) from Domaine de la Romanée-Conti; this listing is the 2022 vintage, a more generous crop after tiny 2021 yields. Critics describe ripe red berries, orange zest and spice framed by toasty oak, full-bodied and firmer and more tightly wound than DRC's Échézeaux.
notes.925458: Romanée-Saint-Vivant is a Grand Cru red Burgundy made from Pinot Noir by Domaine de la Romanée-Conti; this listing is the 2022 vintage.
notes.925459: Richebourg is a Grand Cru red Burgundy made from Pinot Noir by Domaine de la Romanée-Conti; this listing is the 2022 vintage, a rich, generous year for the Domaine.
notes.925460: La Tâche is a Grand Cru red Burgundy (Pinot Noir) from Domaine de la Romanée-Conti; this listing is the 2022 vintage. Critics describe sweet red berries and plums with rose petal, orange zest, spice and incense, full-bodied and layered with fine, powdery tannins and a long finish.
notes.925461: Romanée-Conti is the namesake Grand Cru red Burgundy of Domaine de la Romanée-Conti, one of the most sought-after wines in the world; this listing is the 2022 vintage, after a frost-hit 2021. Tasters describe deep, velvety dark red berries and peony, built to age for decades.
notes.925462: Le Montrachet is one of Burgundy's most famous Grand Cru vineyards, straddling Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet; this is Domaine de la Romanée-Conti's 2022 bottling, from a rich, generous vintage. Tasters note a long, concentrated palate and a buttery finish, with the expectation that it needs years in bottle.
notes.925463: Domaine de la Romanée-Conti's Corton-Charlemagne is a Grand Cru white Burgundy made from Chardonnay, from nearly three hectares in Aloxe-Corton and Pernand-Vergelesses leased from Bonneau du Martray; this listing is the 2022 vintage. Critics describe golden orchard fruit, honey, white flowers and toasted hazelnut, full-bodied with a chalky finish.
notes.936014: Springbank 15 is a Campbeltown single malt matured mainly in sherry casks and bottled at 46% with natural color and no chill filtration. Expect dark fruit, orange and chocolate with tobacco, old oak, a little smoke and a salty, earthy edge. It's made in small batches and is often hard to find.
notes.004656: Bunnahabhain 12 is an unpeated Islay single malt aged at least 12 years in ex-sherry and ex-bourbon casks, bottled non-chill-filtered and naturally colored at 46.3% ABV. Expect dried fruit, toasted nuts, honey and vanilla with a light sea-salt note, coastal rather than smoky.
notes.005433: Laphroaig Quarter Cask is Islay single malt matured first in ex-bourbon barrels, then finished in small quarter casks that give more wood contact, and bottled non-chill-filtered at 48% ABV. Expect Laphroaig's medicinal peat smoke, seaweed and iodine softened by vanilla, caramel and oak spice.
notes.006155: Oban 12 Special Release is part of Diageo's annual Special Releases, a limited, higher-strength take on this coastal Highland single malt; the cask recipe and strength change by year (the 2025 edition was all ex-bourbon at 54.7% ABV). Expect honeyed orchard and tropical fruit, vanilla and biscuit, with wood spice and a light sea-breeze note.
notes.006162: Càirdeas is Laphroaig's annual limited release for its Friends of Laphroaig community, and the cask recipe changes every year (recent editions used port and wine casks, French oak, or a cask-strength Cask Lore). Expect classic Laphroaig: medicinal peat smoke, sea salt, citrus and spice, shaped by that year's casks.
notes.006418: Glenmorangie The Original is the Highland distillery's signature single malt, now aged 12 years (up from 10) in first-fill and refill ex-bourbon casks and bottled at 40% ABV. Light and approachable: citrus, vanilla, fresh cream, apple and pear, with gentle oak.
notes.006459: Laphroaig Elements is an experimental, non-chill-filtered Islay single malt series where each release explores one part of how whisky is made; Elements 2.0, for example, used fermentations of up to 115 hours. Expect Laphroaig's peat smoke alongside unusually fruity notes such as green apple, orange peel and tropical fruit.
notes.008940: Amber Meadow is part of The Macallan's limited Harmony Collection, a single malt matured in sherry-seasoned oak and ex-bourbon casks and meant to evoke a Scottish autumn. Reviewers find orange, plum and dried apricot with chestnut honey, vanilla and almond.
notes.008987: The Classic Laddie 10 is Bruichladdich's unpeated single malt from Islay, now carrying a 10-year age statement. Expect fresh barley, lemon zest, green apple, honey and vanilla with a light coastal saltiness, rather than the smoke most Islay whiskies are known for.
notes.010785: Crown Royal Blackberry is a limited-edition, summer-season flavored whisky: Crown Royal Canadian whiskies infused with blackberry flavor and bottled at 70 proof. Expect blackberry jam and vanilla with a light tartness on the finish; made for mixing and sipping over ice.
notes.010791: Crown Royal Vanilla is a blend of Canadian whiskies infused with Madagascar bourbon vanilla. Expect rich vanilla bean, butterscotch and caramel with a little oak and spice, finishing creamy and sweet.
notes.010802: Crown Royal Peach is a blend of Canadian whiskies infused with Georgia peach flavor. Expect fuzzy peach skin and peach-ring sweetness over Crown Royal's vanilla, caramel and light oak, with a sweet finish. Mostly used in highballs and shots.
notes.010807: Crown Royal Regal Apple is a blend of Canadian whiskies infused with Gala apple flavor, bottled at 70 proof. Expect slightly tart, crisp apple with hints of caramel and light spice; it's mostly mixed or poured over ice.
notes.011298: Crown Royal (Deluxe) is a blended Canadian whisky bottled at 40% ABV, softer and sweeter than most bourbon or Scotch. Expect honey, caramel and vanilla with light toasted oak, a little dried fruit and a gentle rye spice on the finish.
notes.011788: Black Velvet is a blended Canadian whisky made mostly from corn and, since 2019, owned by Heaven Hill. Light and sweet with honey, vanilla and caramel; it's built for mixing more than sipping.
notes.014268: Potters Crown is a blended Canadian whisky made for easy drinking: soft and smooth, with sweet oak, fruit, honey and gentle spice. Neat, on the rocks or mixed.
notes.015626: Jameson is a blended Irish whiskey of pot still and grain whiskeys, triple distilled and aged at least four years in ex-bourbon and ex-sherry casks, bottled at 80 proof. It's light and sweet, with caramel, vanilla, toasted wood and a little fruit and spice.
notes.015862: Redbreast 12 Cask Strength is a single pot still Irish whiskey, made from malted and unmalted barley, aged in ex-bourbon and Oloroso sherry casks and bottled uncut; the strength varies by batch. Expect a creamy, oily texture with caramel, stewed fruit, citrus and vanilla, then a long finish of oak, cinnamon and pepper.
notes.016009: Nikka From the Barrel is a blended whisky from Japan's Nikka, combining malt and grain whiskies (largely from its Yoichi and Miyagikyo distilleries), re-casked together after blending and bottled at 51.4% ABV. Expect vanilla, caramel, dried fruit and plenty of oak and spice, with a long, oily finish.
notes.016850: Blanton's Single Barrel, the first modern single-barrel bourbon, is drawn from individual barrels at Buffalo Trace Distillery and bottled at 93 proof; each label notes the date its barrel was dumped, under the famous horse-and-jockey stopper. Expect caramel, vanilla, honey and orange peel with light spice, leather and charred oak.
notes.016873: Blanton's Gold is a higher-proof version of Blanton's single-barrel bourbon from Buffalo Trace, bottled at 103 proof; this bottle comes from a barrel picked through Sazerac's barrel select program. Reviewers find dried fruit, citrus, honey, toffee and vanilla, with more pepper and a longer, spicier finish than the original. Each barrel differs a little.
notes.016874: A Blanton's Single Barrel bourbon chosen through Sazerac's barrel select program for a store or group. Blanton's comes from Buffalo Trace's Warehouse H and is bottled at 93 proof; expect vanilla, caramel and butterscotch with citrus, oak and baking spice. Each barrel tastes a little different.
notes.017022: John J. Bowman is a single-barrel bourbon from Virginia's A. Smith Bowman Distillery, bottled at 100 proof from barrels the distillery describes as some of its oldest. Expect caramel, vanilla, toasted oak and green apple with chocolate and leather, and a long, gently spicy finish.
notes.017681: A single barrel of Eagle Rare, Buffalo Trace's 10-year-old, 90-proof bourbon made from its high-rye mash bill, chosen by a store or group through Sazerac's barrel select program. Expect toffee, orange peel, honey and leather with candied almond, cocoa and a dry oak finish. Each barrel differs a little.
notes.017766: Eagle Rare 10 is a Kentucky straight bourbon from Buffalo Trace Distillery, aged at least 10 years and bottled at 90 proof. Buffalo Trace describes toffee, orange peel, herbs, honey, leather and oak on the nose, and candied almonds and rich cocoa on a dry, lingering finish.
notes.017927: A single-barrel Elijah Craig bourbon chosen by a store or tasting group and bottled at 94 proof. Each barrel differs a little, but Heaven Hill's house style shows through: brown sugar, caramel and vanilla, some stone fruit and oak, and a warm, peppery finish.
notes.017928: A single barrel of Elijah Craig Toasted Barrel selected by a store or group and bottled uncut at barrel proof. Heaven Hill matures the bourbon, then finishes it in a second, custom-toasted barrel; expect toasted marshmallow, caramel, dried fruit and baking spice with plenty of oak. Proof and flavor vary by barrel.
notes.017929: A single barrel of Elijah Craig bourbon picked by a store or group and bottled uncut at barrel proof, often well above 120 proof. Heaven Hill's low-rye mash bill (78% corn, 12% malted barley, 10% rye) shows as caramel, brown sugar, roasted nuts and baking spice under heavy oak. Age, proof and flavor vary by barrel.
notes.018337: Four Roses' annual Limited Edition Small Batch, bottled at barrel strength. The 2026 edition blends four of the distillery's ten recipes, aged 14 to 23 years, at 54.6% ABV. Four Roses describes apricot and oak on the nose, then baking spice, honey and wood, with a long finish of fruit, vanilla and caramel.
notes.019068: Jim Beam is the standard white-label Kentucky straight bourbon from James B. Beam Distilling Co., made from a 77% corn, 13% rye, 10% malted barley mash bill. It's light and easygoing: corn, caramel and vanilla with a touch of fruit and honey and a mellow, medium finish.
notes.019223: Knob Creek Blender's Edition is a limited series from James B. Beam Distilling Co. that shows off barrel blending; the first release, Edition 01, is a 10-year-old bourbon at 106 proof chosen for Knob Creek's sweeter side. Expect vanilla bean, caramel, brown sugar and cherry jam with seasoned oak and black pepper.
notes.019231: Knob Creek 18 is a limited-edition Kentucky straight bourbon aged 18 years, twice as long as the flagship, and bottled at Knob Creek's traditional 100 proof. Expect deep caramelized oak, brown sugar and char with sweet vanilla and baking spice.
notes.019243: Knob Creek 15 is a limited-release Kentucky straight bourbon aged 15 years and bottled at 100 proof, from the same 77% corn, 13% rye, 10% malted barley mash bill as the rest of the line. Aged oak leads, with leather, caramel and dark fruit underneath.
notes.019498: Maker's Mark 101 is the classic Maker's Mark wheated bourbon bottled at a higher 101 proof. Expect butterscotch, holiday spice, cherry and baked fruit, with a longer, warmer finish than the standard bottle.
notes.019876: Michter's 10 Year is a single-barrel Kentucky straight bourbon, aged at least ten years in fire-charred new American oak and bottled at 94.4 proof in limited quantities. Michter's describes big dark toffee and caramel, charred oak, maple syrup and vanilla; reviewers add roasted almond and brown butter.
notes.020380: Old Forester's single-barrel bourbon bottled at full barrel strength (often around 130 proof) from barrels picked by stores and groups. It uses Old Forester's 72% corn, 18% rye, 10% malted barley mash bill; expect dark cherry, banana, vanilla and roasted pecan with a long, hot, oak-heavy finish. Each barrel tastes a little different.
notes.021297: Series X of Remus Repeal Reserve, the annual limited release from the Ross & Squibb Distillery in Lawrenceburg, Indiana. It blends bourbons distilled between 2008 and 2017 from several high-rye mash bills, including some 18-year-old whiskey, at 107 proof. Reviewers note butterscotch, toffee, cream soda and dark fruit with seasoned oak and rye spice.
notes.021602: Colonel E.H. Taylor Small Batch is a Bottled-in-Bond bourbon from Buffalo Trace Distillery: aged at least four years, bottled at 100 proof, and made from Buffalo Trace's Mash Bill #1. Reviewers describe caramel, vanilla and toasted oak with orange zest, apricot and rye spice, and a long, peppery finish.
notes.021946: Wild Turkey Kentucky Spirit is a single-barrel bourbon, one of the first on the market, bottled at Wild Turkey's 101 proof; each neck label is handwritten with the barrel number, date and warehouse. Wild Turkey describes a full, round body with vanilla, almond and honey, and a finish of oak, caramel and leather.
notes.022037: W.L. Weller Antique is Buffalo Trace's wheated bourbon bottled at 107 proof; using wheat instead of rye as the second grain gives it a softer, rounder style. Expect honey, vanilla, caramel and toasted marshmallow with cherry and dark fruit, a full, oily body and a cinnamon-spiced finish.
notes.022042: W.L. Weller C.Y.P.B. ("Craft Your Perfect Bourbon") is the wheated bourbon that over 100,000 drinkers voted for in a Buffalo Trace survey: aged on the highest warehouse floors and bottled at 95 proof. Buffalo Trace describes a light nose of citrus and oak and a rounded, balanced palate; reviewers add toasted marshmallow, honey and cherry. The finish is medium-long with vanilla.
notes.022046: W.L. Weller Single Barrel is Buffalo Trace's wheated bourbon bottled one barrel at a time, so no two are quite the same. Buffalo Trace describes cherry and mint on the nose with vanilla, cocoa, cinnamon and pepper; reviewers also find orange peel, apricot and baked apple over new oak.
notes.022106: Master's Keep Beacon is a limited Wild Turkey release blending 10-year-old bourbon distilled by Bruce Russell with 16-year-old bourbon distilled by Master Distiller Eddie Russell, bottled at 118 proof. Expect chocolate-covered cherry, toffee, butterscotch and orange with leather, old oak and baking spice.
notes.022177: Russell's Reserve 15 is a limited, non-chill-filtered Kentucky straight bourbon from Wild Turkey's Eddie Russell, aged 15 years and bottled at 117.2 proof from the 75% corn, 13% rye, 12% malted barley mash bill. Expect dark fruit, caramel and brown sugar with pronounced tobacco, leather and mature oak, and a long, spicy finish.
notes.022178: Russell's Reserve Single Barrel is Wild Turkey bourbon bottled one barrel at a time at 110 proof and non-chill filtered, from the 75% corn, 13% rye, 12% malted barley mash bill. Russell's Reserve describes creamy toffee and vanilla with nuts, brown sugar, oak and cinnamon; each barrel has its own character.
notes.022179: Russell's Reserve 13 is a limited, non-chill-filtered Wild Turkey bourbon aged at least 13 years and bottled at barrel proof, which changes with each annual release. Expect cherry and red fruit, vanilla cream, brown sugar and baking spice, with a dry finish of seasoned oak, leather and tobacco.
notes.024480: Knob Creek Bourbon x Rye blends 30% 9-year-old Kentucky straight bourbon with 70% 7-year-old Kentucky straight rye, bottled at 113 proof. The rye leads: expect vanilla and caramel with plenty of pepper and spice over light oak.
notes.025736: The Heaven Hill Heritage Collection is a limited annual release of extra-aged straight American whiskey from Heaven Hill's oldest barrels; the age, mash bill and proof change every spring. Recent bourbon editions, aged 18 to 22 years, show deep charred oak, molasses, dark cherry and leather.
notes.027219: Michter's US★1 Toasted Barrel Finish Rye starts with fully matured Kentucky straight rye at barrel strength, then finishes it in a second barrel of air-dried wood that is toasted rather than charred. It's a limited release around 109 proof; expect toffee, black walnut, cherry and gingerbread with pronounced rye spice and rounded oak.
notes.028391: Michter's US★1 Barrel Strength Sour Mash is the barrel-strength version of Michter's Sour Mash Whiskey, a Kentucky whiskey whose grain recipe falls between a bourbon and a rye, so it is neither. It's a limited release (the 2026 edition averaged 111.5 proof); Michter's describes cherry, plum and cocoa with balanced spice and a honeyed, dessert-like sweetness.
notes.031473: New Amsterdam Gin is an American gin in a contemporary, citrus-forward style: light lemon and candied orange lead, with juniper and herbs at the edges. Lighter on pine than a London dry; it suits a gin and tonic.
notes.034458: Ketel One is a Dutch vodka from the Nolet family distillery, 40% ABV, partly distilled in copper pot stills and named after the family's original 1864 still. Very clean and silky, with a light black-pepper tingle and faint citrus, fennel and liquorice.
notes.034515: Monopolowa is a potato vodka from J.A. Baczewski, a distiller founded in 1782 near Lviv and now based in Austria, bottled at 80 proof. It's light and clean, with the slightly creamy texture potato vodkas are known for.
notes.034821: Svedka is a Swedish vodka (the name blends "Svenska" and vodka), made from winter wheat, distilled five times and bottled at 80 proof. Clean and crisp with a subtle, rounded sweetness; a mixing vodka.
notes.035418: Burnett's is an American grain vodka from Heaven Hill in Bardstown, Kentucky, bottled at 80 proof. It's a budget mixing vodka: neutral, with a slight bitterness neat.
notes.036117: Five Wives is a Utah vodka from Ogden's Own Distillery in Ogden, distilled in column stills from 100% corn and made with Utah mountain spring water, so it's naturally gluten-free. Clean and smooth with a hint of sweetness, for sipping cold or mixing.
notes.036759: Dented Brick Craft Vodka is made in Utah from 100% locally grown corn and artesian well water from the Wasatch Mountains. Judges describe sweet, oily corn notes with a peppery spice that lingers through the finish.
notes.036900: Barton Naturals is an American vodka distilled from all-natural ingredients and bottled at 80 proof; this listing is the plastic bottle. Clean and neutral, made for mixing.
notes.036971: New Amsterdam is an American vodka, distilled five times and filtered three times, at 80 proof. It's clean and neutral with a soft sweetness and a faint citrus finish, made for mixing.
notes.038088: Platinum 7X is an American vodka distilled seven times from grain and made since 1996. It's clean and neutral, with a light grain note and a dry, crisp finish, built for mixing.
notes.038093: Platinum 10X is an American grain vodka from the Sazerac Company, distilled ten times and bottled at 80 proof. Clean and neutral with a slight sweetness and little burn; a mixing vodka.
notes.040053: Deep Eddy Lemon is Deep Eddy's Original Vodka made with real lemon juice, bottled at 70 proof: sweet and tart, like a spiked lemonade.
notes.042385: Barbarossa is a Caribbean spiced rum with vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and caramel; easygoing and sweet, made for mixing.
notes.043337: Captain Morgan Original Spiced Rum blends Caribbean rum with a spice recipe and is bottled at 70 proof. It's sweet and vanilla-forward with brown sugar, caramel, cinnamon and clove and a short, lightly peppery finish; made for mixing.
notes.045888: Sailor Jerry is a Caribbean spiced rum named for tattoo artist Norman "Sailor Jerry" Collins, bottled at 92 proof, drier and stronger than most spiced rums. Vanilla and cinnamon lead, with clove, nutmeg, caramel, toffee and a hint of lime.
notes.057378: BuzzBallz Biggies Grapes Gone Wild is a party-size, ready-to-drink cocktail from Texas-based BuzzBallz, at 15% ABV. It's sweet and candy-like with bold Concord grape, a hint of berry and a light tang; serve it cold or over ice.
notes.062644: Monaco Watermelon Crush is a canned tequila cocktail at 9% ABV, about two shots of spirit per can, so it's much stronger than a hard seltzer. Expect bold, sweet watermelon with a touch of tartness.
notes.062869: A canned vodka cocktail from Salt Lake City's Sugar House Distillery, made with the distillery's own vodka (distilled from local grain) and white peach flavor.
notes.064864: Fireball is a cinnamon-flavored whisky, Canadian whisky blended with cinnamon flavoring and sweeteners, made by the Sazerac Company; this listing is the plastic travel-friendly bottle. Expect red-hot cinnamon candy up front, then a sweet, warming finish; it's usually served as a cold shot.
notes.064868: Fireball is a cinnamon-flavored whisky, Canadian whisky blended with cinnamon flavoring and sweeteners, made by the Sazerac Company. Expect red-hot cinnamon candy up front, then a sweet, warming finish; it's usually served as a cold shot.
notes.075176: Kamchatka Vodka with Premium Liqueur blends vodka with a sweet liqueur, so it's lower in proof and sweeter than straight vodka. Expect vanilla and honey with a hint of spice.
notes.080458: Ryan's is an Irish-style cream liqueur blending dairy cream, chocolate, natural vanilla and imported Irish whiskey, at 34 proof. Rich and sweet; neat over ice, in coffee or in cocktails.
notes.085788: LALO is a tequila blanco from the Los Altos region of Jalisco, made from only three ingredients (mature blue Weber agave, Champagne yeast and deep-well water), twice distilled and unaged, at 40% ABV. Clean and crisp: bright citrus, herbal agave, light floral notes and a little pepper.
notes.087380: Corazón de Agave Blanco is an unaged tequila from Casa San Matías, a family-owned agave estate in Jalisco, estate-grown, distilled and hand-bottled. Clean, clear and crisp, with cooked agave and citrus.
notes.088321: Piedra Azul Blanco is a 100% blue Weber agave tequila from the Los Altos region of Jalisco, distilled at the century-old La Madrileña distillery in Tototlán and bottled at 80 proof. Expect light citrus, vanilla and sweet earth, finishing clean with a touch of caramel and honey.
notes.089242: Corralejo Reposado is a 100% blue Weber agave tequila from the brand's own estate in Guanajuato, double distilled in Charentais-style pot stills and rested about four months in French, American and Mexican oak, at 40% ABV. Expect vanilla, honey, cooked agave and light oak with lemon-lime and peppercorn.
notes.089286: Espolòn Reposado is a 100% blue Weber agave tequila from Destilería San Nicolás in the Jalisco highlands, rested at least two months in American oak. Expect roasted agave, tropical fruit, vanilla and caramel with warming spice.
